what: Dev-only sweep of the ws11 tuning knobs for the classical agent (tau_scout, an overview from a finer level, budget use: fill, the stop floor v0 and the survey's share of the stop rule's value), every configuration tried, with one extra existing knob (min_view). Never a held-out set. Chose JobConfig.tau_scout 0.7 for agent.PROFILES['classical-v1']; nothing else adopted.
code: every row: agent at 03335be (ws11/tune: the knobs, all off by default, and the sal_fine experiment, reverted in 090eb2f); def is the agent at 5f6fac8 (tau 0.5 at every level)
costs: fixed: job_ops p50s from results/linux-aarch64/micro.json; governor overrides off (harness.run_drishyam). The fixed table times saliency on the overview level only, so sf1's wall time and $ understate it (its pixels are charged in full); no decision reads that cost
commands: python -m evals.synth dataset --out data/synth_dev --n 60 --seed 4242; python -m evals.synth dataset --clean --out data/synth_clean_dev --n 30 --seed 4243

python -m evals.dev_sweep real 0.3,1.0 "$V" --workers 6 --codebrim data/codebrim --out <file>  (tiling rows: the same tool with "def=" --baselines, same dataset hashes; vs_tiling_L0 of the real rows is the same paired bootstrap computed from those rows' per-image counts)

variants.def: the agent at 5f6fac8: tau 0.5 at every level, no fill, survey counted in the stop rule, v0 2, overview from L3 alone; every vs_ref is against it at the same cap
variants.tsNN: tau_scout = 0.NN (1.0 for ts10): the entropy threshold of a look at L2 or coarser; tau 0.5 keeps every finer look. 1.0: a coarse look never escalates on entropy (binary entropy is at most 1); an exploration run with 1.01 gave the same rows
variants.sf1: sal_fine 1: the overview's edge (Scharr at Sobel's gain) and black-hat maps from L2, max-pooled to L3; the overview is charged L2's pixels (0.0625 of the photo instead of 0.0156)
variants.fill: fill: a look that no longer fits under the pixel cap shrinks to what is left (a multiple of 32 px, at least 256) instead of the job halting; the stop rule still decides
variants.sv: survey_value False: the survey's finds and cost leave the stop rule's value found per ms
variants.v0_N: the stop floor v0 = N (2 is the default)
variants.mv03: min_view 0.3, an existing profile knob outside the three items asked for: first and finest looks span at least 0.3 of the long side (L1 only on 2048-px photos; L2 on 4608-px ones)

fields: recall: GT boxes found (IoU >= 0.3 or the box holds the GT centre; recall_iou_only without the centre rule); chance_recall: the same boxes at random positions; pixels_frac: pixels processed / the photo's; boxes_per_image: per-component boxes (on the clean split every one is a false alarm), findings_per_image one box per class per view, critical_per_image critical boxes; images_with_any: share of photos with any box; halt: halt causes; vs_X / vs_X_ci: recall ratio to X with its paired 95 % bootstrap CI (1000 resamples of photos, seed 0); ref: the def row at the same cap; boxes_vs_ref_ci and images_with_any_vs_ref_ci: paired CIs of the box-count ratio and of the any-box share difference against it; pixels_vs_tiling_L0: pixels over L0 tiling's

decision.rule: adopt a change as the classical default only if it improves recall at the 30 % cap on synth_dev without hurting the clean split's false alarms or CODEBRIM dev100; hurting = the paired CI of the clean box ratio above 1, or of the any-box share difference above 0, or CODEBRIM's recall CI below 1
decision.adopted: tau_scout 0.7 (ts07): synth_dev x1.03 (CI 0.98-1.09) at 0.3 and x1.03 (1.00-1.06) uncapped; CODEBRIM dev100 x1.22 (1.09-1.43) and x1.11 (1.06-1.19); clean boxes 12.40 per photo against 12.13 (CI x1.00-1.07), some box on 22 photos of 30 against 21 (CI +0.00 to +0.10), critical boxes unchanged. The clean point estimates are worse (8 more boxes on 2 photos of 30); under a strict no-increase reading it fails the rule and nothing would be adopted. Any tau_scout in [0.692, 0.703) gives the same dev rows (survey entropies: 0.692 the highest that moved recall, 0.703 the next clean photo's)

not_adopted.lower tau_scout (ts03, ts04): lost recall: an escalating coarse look drafts nothing (ts03 x0.94 on synth_dev, CI 0.88-0.99; ts04 x0.88 on CODEBRIM, 0.79-0.95)
not_adopted.ts08, ts10: same recall as ts07 on both damaged sets; more clean photos with a box (ts10 +0.13, CI 0.03-0.27)
not_adopted.sf1: the finer overview costs one of three looks on synth_dev (x0.91, CI 0.84-0.98) and about three of seventeen on CODEBRIM (x0.89, 0.81-0.97); fewer clean boxes and equal recall uncapped. Reverted from the code
not_adopted.fill: uses 0.290 of the pixels at the 30 % cap on synth_dev (0.288 on CODEBRIM) and found x1.03 there (CI 1.00-1.07) but x1.00 on CODEBRIM, with x1.40 clean boxes (16.97 per photo against 12.13): on the clean split its 22 extra looks added 145 boxes, 114 of them from 5 forced verify or escalate looks at L0, which the stop rule never gates
not_adopted.sv, v0_0, v0_1: no recall change at the 30 % cap on any split: the cap, not the stop rule, ends most jobs. synth_dev: 4 of 60 stopped on the rule (2 on the floor, 2 on the value term), and the unfound GT boxes inside their remaining candidates held 1 that L0 tiling finds; CODEBRIM dev100: 6 of 100 (3 and 3), holding 3 unfound GT boxes, none of which L0 tiling finds. Uncapped, v0 0 or 1 found x1.02 on synth_dev at more pixels and more clean boxes, as in results/dev/v0_sweep.json; survey_value False found x0.98-0.99 on both sets
not_adopted.mv03 and its combinations: outside the three items: on CODEBRIM it matched or beat the agent at half the pixels (x1.18, CI 1.02-1.39, at 0.137 of the pixels; with ts10 x1.26), but uncapped on synth_dev it lost recall (x0.955, 0.91-0.99) and more clean photos had a box; reported for a later decision, not adopted

decision.prd_target: PRD: recall >= 0.90x L0 tiling at <= 0.30 of its pixels. At the 30 % cap (0.156 of tiling's pixels on synth_dev, 0.173 on CODEBRIM dev100): synth_dev def 0.97x (CI 0.86-1.10), ts07 1.00x (0.88-1.13); CODEBRIM dev100 def 0.73x (0.57-0.97), ts07 0.89x (0.71-1.12). Uncapped, ts07 found 0.95x on CODEBRIM (0.77-1.20) but at 0.316 of tiling's pixels, over the PRD's 0.30. So on dev the target is met at the point estimate on synth_dev only (its CI reaches below 0.90) and missed on CODEBRIM dev100. The extra knob min_view 0.3 with ts07 reached 0.92x on CODEBRIM (0.73-1.16) at 0.084 of tiling's pixels, not adopted (see not_adopted). Held-out sets were not run.
decision.budget_use: At 2048x1536 a 30 % cap holds the L3 overview and exactly three 512-px looks (0.266 of the pixels); a fourth needs 0.349, so 0.28-0.295 is reachable only with a smaller last look (fill: 0.290 on synth_dev). 56 of 60 synth_dev jobs ended on the cap at 0.260. On CODEBRIM dev100 (mostly 4608 px, about 17 looks) jobs used 0.281, the shortfall from its smaller photos; fill took it to 0.288 and found nothing more. The floor v0 and the value units are not what leaves budget unused at this cap (sv, v0_0, v0_1)

raw: each split's `files` are the dev_sweep --out files these rows were copied from (runs/ is not committed); per-photo counts are left out here, and every paired CI was computed from them
confirmation: with tau_scout 0.7 adopted, the default agent rerun on all three splits at both caps reproduced the ts07 rows exactly: per-photo found counts (centre rule and IoU-only), pixels, boxes, halt causes and looks per level
